summary_markdown: The discussion focused on defining how data should be delivered to jcdecaux. [p1] suggested creating a document (possibly in Google Docs) to outline the requirements. [me] questioned the feasibility of using Google Docs for technical specifications, asking if real-time data and an API would be required. [me] also clarified that 'real-time' meant providing raw numerical data, not just visualizations via Grafana.
decisions: The team needs to document the desired data delivery format for jcdecaux.
action_items: Someone should start drafting the requirements document.
